practicals.title: Assignment 1
content: Draw the dimensional sketches of a cross-section of the railway
track (with the function of each part of the track).

practicals.title: Assignment 2
content: Draw the sketches of both left and right-hand turnout and crossing
of the railway track showing each part of the track.

practicals.title: Assignment 3
content: Draw sketches of the different types of the harbour, piers, quay
walls, jetties, quays, piers, and jetties Breakwaters beacons, beacon
light, floating navigation aids, and coastal protection work.

practicals.title: Assignment 4
content: Draw sketches of various shapes and sizes of tunnels.

practicals.title: Assignment 5
content: The topic of the Seminar shall be given to a group of students or on
an individual basis. The students are required to submit and
present/defend the Seminar in the presence of students and teachers
and the report including a PowerPoint presentation to be attached
with the submission. Each individual student’s contribution to group
work needs to be made explicit.

practicals.title: Assignment 6
content: Based on the curriculum-related topic narrating the case study of
railway, Harbour and tunnel engineering with specific safety
operations/ problems faced in the field.

practicals.title: Assignment 7
content: Visit a railway station & yards and/or nearby jetty and/or for
observing various elements of respective structures and prepare a
brief report.
Total Hours 28
